data.description:
*DodgeALL* is a high-intensity VR game that puts your agility and reflexes to the test. Engage in a world where the only rule is to dodge everything that comes your way! With immersive 3D environments and physics-based gameplay, each level presents a new challenge, offering endless replayability. Dodge, weave, and strategize in this adrenaline-fueled game, where your skill determines your survival. 

Are you ready to DodgeALL?

# Features include:
- Room-scale & 360 degrees: Where you can move IRL is where you can move in-game.
- 3D Spatial Audio: Gives audible cues where obstacles are coming from.
- Abilities: 5 different unlockable abilities to help when you're lazy.
- Endless Mode: Play any unlocked level until you drop. Each iteration gets progressively faster.
- Leaderboards: Compare your dodging skills to other players.
- Interactive Twitch mode: Let your viewers throw things at you!
- Custom levels: Design your own levels.

changelog.change_log:
VERSION: 0.40.6.0
BUGFIX: Obstacles now play audio correctly when moving (huge regression in 40.2.0)!!!
BUGFIX: Arena ambience ambisonic audio now plays correctly when teleporting.
BUGFIX: Cleaned up SciFiHardwareStore world.
BUGFIX: Shield tutorial level can now be completed after blocking 2 obstacles.
BUGFIX: Tutorial now shows correct controllers for all Quest devices.
CHANGE: Changed some tutorial level text to be less confusing.

VERSION: 0.40.5.0
FEATURE: Added level rating screen in Scoreboard.
FEATURE: Endless mode now shows how long (seconds) player survived.
FEATURE: Endless mode Leaderboards now show time instead of points.
FEATURE: Added new Endless mode achievements.
FEATURE: Endless scoreboard now shows how many obstacles dodged.
CHANGE: SciFi > Virus02 now clones in a different direction.
CHANGE: Starting level UI now shows if Endless or Campaign; same with ScoreBoard.
CHANGE: Aborting Endless level no longer adds score to leaderboard.
CHANGE: SciFi > Crystal now spawns clones in random directions.
BUGFIX: ScrapFan clones now separate correctly.
BUGFIX: Maximum obstacle speed correctly implemented for endless mode and custom level files.
BUGFIX: Closest possible dodge distance is now 0.01 instead of 0.
BUGFIX: Clones launched from 45-degree portals now slide correctly to position relative to parent.
BUGFIX: Achievement Unlocked description no longer chops text in 2nd line.
BUGFIX: Pressing Settings > Reset or Player > Reset buttons now return to Main Menu after resetting settings.

FEATURE: Added new SciFi Campaign #2 levels 5-8 and Bonus #2; all other levels should no longer cause errors but are still WIP.
BUGFIX: Some obstacles now no longer collide with some types or all other obstacles.
CHANGE: Increased time of Achievement Unlocked pop-up to 5 seconds.
CHANGE: SciFi > TrashBag now explodes into trash. The player can not dodge this trash and it causes no harm.
CHANGE: Replaced SciFi > Scrap1 with new ScrapPipe; now "boomerangs" back from platform edge.
CHANGE: Replaced SciFi > Scrap2 with new ScrapFan which rotates very quickly.
CHANGE: Obstacles now allowed to target player lower.

FEATURE: Added achievement for when player is hit by all SciFi or Pirates obstacles at least once.
FEATURE: Added achievement for achieving various scores upon successfully completing a level.
BUGFIX: Multiple achievements are now queued and displayed one after another.
BUGFIX: Campaign level score data now saved with correct prefix.
BUGFIX: SciFi > Barrier now collides with environment and player correctly.
CHANGE: Reduced size of Pirates > TreasureChest.
CHANGE: SciFi > Crystal now always creates multiple clones after teleporting.

FEATURE: Pirates boss level can now be completed by hitting other ships with bouncing CannonBalls.
BUGFIX: Arena no longer casts shadows on bridges.
BUGFIX: Bridges are no longer created when moving portals during a level unless needed.
CHANGE: SciFi AlienPlanet > Virus03 now launches in an arc instead of straight line.
CHANGE: Pirates > CannonBall now bounces on platform.

VERSION: 0.40.0.8
BUGFIX: Most obstacles can now target player much lower.
BUGFIX: Test Mode (settings.ini) obstacle interactions re-enabled.
BUGFIX: Level Difficulty Rating adjustments.
CHANGE: Replaced tuturial (HiRes) arena with SciFi arena.
CHANGE: Tutorial levels (2-5) only require user to repeat once instead of twice.
CHANGE: Tutorial UI panel is now inside TV.
CHANGE: Updated SciFi Level 8 and Pirates Level 9, 10, 11 and 12.
CHANGE: Pirates > ShipWheel now launched with random tilt.

VERSION: 0.40.0.7
BUGFIX: Platform outer rings color now fades correctly when level starts (instead of black).
BUGFIX: Select level panels now scroll to the very top when opening.
BUGFIX: Select campaign level text adjusted to not overlap the lock symbol.
BUGFIX: Cleaned up lighting in SciFi arena.
BUGFIX: SciFi DroneFast can now target player much lower.
BUGFIX: Obstacles should no longer get stuck on opposite side portal.
CHANGE: No longer show errors to player unless in Test Mode or in Editor.
